summary: Routt County site named in 1911 Forest Service plans for a lookout station with telephone and trail; no source confirms it was built or what remains.

facts.status_note: No source confirms the station was built.

events.note: The Routt County Republican, dated March 24, 1911, reported 1911 Forest Service plans for a lookout station on Bears Ears. The source does not confirm construction.

evidence.supports: 1911 plan for a lookout station on Bears Ears, with telephone and trail
evidence.quote: Here are some of the plans the forest service has for 1911: lookout station on Bears Ears, with telephone and trail.

notes_for_editor: Only the 1911 plan and a coordinates index describe this site. Brief agency (Routt National Forest) is supported. Brief kind and status stay unknown. Search snippets mentioned a Summit Creek station (1912), a Hog Park house (1910-12) and an NPS Parkview lookout (1915-16); none was fetched, so none is used. A snippet said the Bears Ears District ended in 1918. The fetched PDF says early District #6 existed until 1918 and that a new Bears Ears Ranger District was formed that year, so the story follows the PDF. The Routt NF inventory page has no lookout lines. Two searches and about five page reads used.
